title: A Unified Comparative Study with Generalized Conformity Scores for Multi-Output Conformal Regression
abstract: arXiv:2501.10533v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Conformal prediction provides a powerful framework for constructing distribution-free prediction regions with finite-sample coverage guarantees. While extensively studied in univariate settings, its extension to multi-output problems presents additional challenges, including complex output dependencies and high computational costs, and remains relatively underexplored. In this work, we present a unified comparative study of nine conformal methods with different multivariate base models for constructing multivariate prediction regions within the same framework. This study highlights their key properties while also exploring the connections between them. Additionally, we introduce two novel classes of conformity scores for multi-output regression that generalize their univariate counterparts. translated_title: 面向多输出保形回归的基于广义一致性分数的统一比较研究
translated_abstract: 保形预测提供了一个强大的框架，用于构建具有有限样本覆盖率保证的无分布预测区域。尽管保形预测在单变量场景中已被广泛研究，但将其扩展到多输出问题会带来额外的挑战，包括复杂的输出依赖性和高昂的计算成本，目前仍相对缺乏探索。在这项工作中，我们在同一框架内对九种采用不同多变量基础模型的保形方法进行了统一的比较研究，以构建多变量预测区域。该研究突出了这些方法的关键特性，同时也探讨了它们之间的联系。此外，我们为多输出回归引入了两类新颖的一致性分数，它们是对单变量对应方法的推广。这些分数在保持精确的有限样本边际覆盖率的同时，确保了渐近条件覆盖率。其中一类与……
tldr: 本文对多输出保形回归中的九种保形方法进行了统一比较研究，并提出两类由单变量方法推广而来的新型一致性分数，它们在保持精确有限样本边际覆盖率的同时实现渐近条件覆盖率。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a unified comparative study of nine conformal methods for multi-output conformal regression and introduces two novel classes of conformity scores generalizing their univariate counterparts, which ensure asymptotic conditional coverage while maintaining exact finite-sample marginal coverage.
